test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'INNER’ is written as 'SNNWJ' and 'GLASS' is written as 'UPAII'. How will 'MODEL' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the English alphabet series is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

**Logic:**

**Step 1: Opposite positional letters are written.**

**Step 2: Addition of +1 in opposite positional letters.**

1) 'INNER’ is written as 'SNNWJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dcfb43b4f7489227c0f2d95a1f5c9d40649ba69bcc3f911ff2c7bacd9e1e8af.png] 

And,

2) 'GLASS' is written as 'UPAII'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49390cc4f83109700408afca44fc2d8c9d47044720c9dec2c27809d35f338f0c.png] 

Similarly,

'MODEL' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbf776bca7945ef94941c00f69af77dc81941de4fd82e2f80e64e40421318de0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"OMXWP".**
